$comment: The places a case can arrive from, as objects in OpenRegister's `intake-sources` register (schema `intake-source`, seeded there by OpenRegister's own SeedIntakeSourceRegister repair step). Dossiq contributes the channels it handles; the register and the schema are not dossiq's. `kind` is the TRANSPORT and takes only the three values the schema declares: a portal, an API caller, a KCC desk and a DSO message all arrive over HTTP, so all four are `endpoint` and the `slug` is what tells them apart. `enabled: false` is the switch, not a delete: a source switched off stops being polled and stays listed, so turning a channel off never loses what it was. Every source ships DISABLED, because a source that starts polling on install would poll a mailbox nobody configured. `connection` names an integriq connection by slug rather than holding a credential, and is filled in by whoever configures the channel.

sources.title: Mail
sources.description: Post that arrives by email, through the Nextcloud Mail account the intake filters watch.

sources.title: Portal
sources.description: A request a resident or a business submitted on the portal, arriving as a portal contribution.

sources.title: API
sources.description: A case another system opened over the API, its own reference kept on the record.

sources.title: Contact centre
sources.description: A case a contact centre agent opened on the caller's behalf, from the KCC desk.

sources.title: DSO
sources.description: A request handed over by the Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet (DSO), through the statutory gateway.
